# Kairo

> A performance media buying and customer acquisition agency for local and service-based businesses in the US, built on the idea that the path from attention to revenue should be one connected system.

## What you do

Kairo builds complete customer acquisition systems, not just ad campaigns. Every engagement includes Meta Ads management, Google Ads management, CRM setup with automated SMS and email follow-up, a custom landing page built for the client's city and offer, conversion tracking (Meta Pixel and Conversions API, Google Tag), 15 or more monthly creative variations, weekly performance reporting, and sales process consulting.

The agency was founded on direct, hands-on paid acquisition experience, which shapes how campaigns are targeted, priced, and creatively angled around each client's real unit economics and sales cycle, rather than a generic industry template.

New clients receive a free market audit before any engagement, and their first $500 in ad spend is covered by Kairo. The agency works with only one business per local market.

## Who you work with

Local and service-based business owners in the United States ready to turn paid attention into booked revenue. Active clients are located in Florida, Minnesota, Louisiana, Tennessee, Illinois, and Texas; most other US markets are open.

## How to engage

Book a free 30-minute competitor analysis and growth audit at https://www.kairo.agency/contact.html. No pitch, an honest read on the prospect's market and what a Kairo engagement would look like.
